articles.title: Crypto Clarity Act in spotlight for bad-actor provisions as Senate process grinds forward
articles.snippet: The industry has been trying to make a case this week the Clarity Act provides law enforcement strong tools to combat illicit finance involving cryptocurrency.

articles.title: OCC chief says Democrats applying sole political pressure in World Liberty charter choice
articles.snippet: The regulator rejected claims he's doing President Trump's bidding during a congressional hearing that also addressed the GENIUS Act stablecoin push.

articles.title: 'Dr. Doom'-backed Atlas Capital CEO says bitcoin could crash 70% before reaching $500,000
articles.snippet: Backed by economist Nouriel Roubini, a long-time anti-bitcoin advocate, and known as 'Dr. Doom,' the Atlas CEO, Reza Bundy, shot a short-term warning for bitcoin but stayed bullish in the long-term.

articles.title: Hyperliquid pulls back from record highs as Arthur Hayes exits position shy of $150 price target
articles.snippet: The crypto veteran blamed macro risks and AI mania for taking profits, drawing backlash from traders for selling well below his recent bullish forecasts.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: The crypto due diligence questions you forgot to ask
articles.snippet: As stablecoins, shifting regulation and AI-enabled infrastructure mature, advisors should revisit three questions their crypto due diligence may no longer fully cover.
